{{Quote|Lieutenant Orrell Lockerbee, Corporate Sector Authority ship ''Resolute''.|Orrell Lockerbee, introducing himself to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mander Zuma]]|<ref name="Scourge (novel)">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Orrell Lockerbee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served aboard the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]] [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Lockerbee accompanied the vessel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]], to enforce a quarantine of the world that had been put in place by the CSA.
